text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult woman, age 23. Golden blonde hair in a loose swept-up bun with fine face-framing wisps, fair neutral skin with faint freckles, green-gray eyes, softly tapered oval face, restrained rose lips, light gray-beige crewneck shirt. Light gray-beige crewneck fine-knit sweater, dark charcoal high-waist wide-leg trousers and ivory leather sneakers. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
